instruction: I need to add animations to my slides but the Animation Pane is not showing. Please open the Animation Pane so I can create slide animations.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(2)

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to open the Animation Pane in LibreOffice Impress. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for Animation pane/panel elements.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: Animation Pane is opened/visible
Getter (get_accessibility_tree) extracts the right state for checking UI pane visibility
Metric logic appropriately searches for Animation-related panel elements in accessibility tree
Flexible pattern matching covers multiple naming variations ('Animation', 'Custom Animation', 'Animation Pane', 'Animation Panel')
Error handling present for XML parsing failures
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (open Animation Pane) and evaluator checks exactly that
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding a postconfig to ensure Animation Pane state can be reliably checked if user closes it during execution
Minor: Pattern matching is case-sensitive - may miss localized or differently-cased variants, but acceptable for English LibreOffice
Minor: Could verify visibility state attributes in accessibility tree, not just presence, though presence typically indicates visibility for panes
